correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md gives all four articulation subsets and exact private-capacity triples: (t−1,t−1,t−1), (t−2,t−2,t−1), (t−1,t−2,t−2), (t−2,t−3,t−2). The augmented simplex-skeleton chain complex is the exterior algebra with contraction by the coordinate-sum map, split over Z; hence its only homology is ∧^k U in degree k−1, including k=0. The filtered join chain complexes have sole graded homology in degrees d,d−1,d−1,d−2 for filtration 0,1,1,2, opposite to the direction needed for homological differentials, with a unique filtration in each degree. All differentials vanish and integral module extensions are absent. This proves the three tensor-product exterior-power lattices and Betti products for all t≥3,p,q,r≥t. The Ghosh–Selvaraja block-graph shellability theorem and the Björner–Wachs nonpure shellability wedge theorem upgrade Betti numbers to the asserted nonequivariant homotopy type. Independent direct-face enumeration at t=p=q=r=3 gives 583 augmented faces and binary Betti β3=4,β4=8,β5=1; a finite check is only corroboration of the unlimited proof.
